findings.applicability: Critic citations of frozen facts versus checker namespace.
findings.explanation: The recorded UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE rejection arose because the checker accepted only source-record IDs while Critic cited valid frozen fact hashes; the CITATION_NAMESPACE_DEFECT annotation attributes this to the contract service. Critic's advisory objection correctly asked for exact source scope.

limitations: Human finding decisions supplied via the project conversation and transcribed by Codex. The reviewer and transcribing assessor are outcome-exposed; REVIEWED does not imply an outcome-blind assessment.
The assessor had read later development results, corrections and the 2.12/2.13 audit before assessing; this is not an ex-ante assessment.
The reference-checker defect supports an engineering correction, not a negative method lesson that Critic must cite evidence correctly: the citations in this case were valid.

Critic missed the mixed falsifier in Mini v2 and recognized the distinction in the v3 correction. Different, inherited proposal content prevents attributing that contrast to newly learned Critic capability or a measured feedback effect.
reason: Explicit human review supplied in the project conversation on 10 October 2026; Codex transcribed the finding decisions and limitations. Original assessment retained by supersession; no new agent inference or market evaluation. v3 corrected revision critique: valid fact-hash citations were rejected by a checker defect, not by a Critic error.
